title: MSFS Marketplace Update April 2026: 13 New Activities for PC!
description:
In the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update for April 23, 2026, this week brings a fresh set of new activities for PC pilots including the must‑have Around the World in 80 Flights that’s perfect for long‑haul simmers looking to recreate the classic Jules Verne adventure in the skies! 😄

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Koschi: Around the World in 80 Flights (Epic globe-spanning mission adventure)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8LEGS World Tour Challenge (Multi-leg global touring missions)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Advanced Challenges – Epic Landings Vol. 1 (Precision landing skill-testers)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – AEE [Winter 2025] (Aegean Airlines seasonal operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – CMP [Winter 2025] (Transavia seasonal routes)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – IGO [Winter 2025] (Transavia seasonal routes)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – RJA [Winter 2025] (Transavia seasonal routes)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – TRA [Winter 2025] (Transavia seasonal routes)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – EIDW [Winter 2025] (Dublin international flight schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – KLAS [Winter 2025] (Las Vegas live traffic simulation)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – OLBA [Winter 2025] (Las Vegas live traffic simulation)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – VVNB [Winter 2025] (Las Vegas live traffic simulation)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – YSCB [Winter 2025] (Las Vegas live traffic simulation)

Thanks for watching and happy flying everyone. ✈️ See you in the skies!
